result.instructions: Tools for NFe.io, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Look up the company with CNPJ 11.222.333/0001-81 and tell me its status and address."; "Which postal code is Avenida Paulista in São Paulo, and what is its city code?"; "List the service invoices we issued in October and show any that were cancelled.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes NFe.io data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run nfeio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run nfeio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run nfeio_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. nfeio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: nfeio_lookup_cnpj
tools.title: Look up a CNPJ
tools.description: Look up a Brazilian company (CNPJ): legal name, trade name, status, main activity and address, from the Receita Federal data. Data key. GET /v2/legalentities/basicInfo/{federalTaxNumber}.

tools.name: nfeio_lookup_state_tax
tools.title: Look up state tax registration
tools.description: Look up the state tax registration (Inscrição Estadual) of a CNPJ in one state. Data key. GET /v2/legalentities/stateTaxInfo/{state}/{federalTaxNumber}.

tools.name: nfeio_lookup_cep
tools.title: Look up a postal code (CEP)
tools.description: Look up a Brazilian postal code (CEP): street, district, city, state and IBGE city code. Data key. GET /v2/addresses/{postalCode}.

tools.name: nfeio_get_product_invoice
tools.title: Get an NF-e from SEFAZ by access key
tools.description: Query a product invoice (NF-e) by its 44-digit access key, directly at SEFAZ: issuer, items, totals and status. Data key. GET /v2/productinvoices/{accessKey}.

annotations.title: Get an NF-e by access key

tools.name: nfeio_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List the active companies (issuers) of this NFe.io account, with their ids and tax numbers. Invoice key. GET /v1/companies.

tools.name: nfeio_get_company
tools.title: Get a company
tools.description: Get one company by its NFe.io id or its CNPJ, with registration, municipal tax number and certificate status. Invoice key. GET /v1/companies/{company_id_or_tax_number}.

company.description: NFe.io company id, or the company's tax number.

tools.name: nfeio_list_service_invoices
tools.title: List service invoices (NFS-e)
tools.description: List the service invoices (NFS-e) of one company, optionally by issue or creation date range. Invoice key. GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/serviceinvoices.

companyId.description: NFe.io id (from the list or get tools).

tools.name: nfeio_get_service_invoice
tools.title: Get a service invoice (NFS-e)
tools.description: Get one service invoice (NFS-e) by its NFe.io id: status, number, verification code, amounts and borrower. Invoice key. GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/serviceinvoices/{id}.

companyId.description: NFe.io id (from the list or get tools).

invoiceId.description: NFe.io id (from the list or get tools).

tools.name: nfeio_get_service_invoice_by_external_id
tools.title: Get a service invoice by your external id
tools.description: Get one service invoice (NFS-e) by the externalId you sent when issuing it. Invoice key. GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/serviceinvoices/external/{id}.

companyId.description: NFe.io id (from the list or get tools).

externalId.description: The externalId you sent at issue time.

annotations.title: Get a service invoice by external id

tools.name: nfeio_issue_service_invoice
tools.title: Issue a service invoice (NFS-e)
tools.description: WRITE, creates a legal service invoice (NFS-e) in the city's tax system for the company. Use only when the user asked to issue it. The call is asynchronous: NFe.io answers 202 and the invoice status becomes final later (check with nfeio_get_service_invoice or nfeio_get_service_invoice_by_external_id). Invoice key. POST /v1/companies/{company_id}/serviceinvoices.

companyId.description: NFe.io id (from the list or get tools).

externalId.description: Your own id for this invoice; use it to find the invoice later.

cnaeCode.description: CNAE code, only where the city needs it.

issuedOn.description: Issue date, ISO 8601 date-time with offset (issuedOn).

taxationType.description: ISS taxation type (taxationType). Pick the value that matches the service.

borrower.description: Customer (borrower): type (NaturalPerson or LegalEntity), name, federalTaxNumber (number, CNPJ or CPF), email, municipalTaxNumber, address. Omit for no customer.

tools.name: nfeio_cancel_service_invoice
tools.title: Cancel a service invoice (NFS-e)
tools.description: WRITE, DESTRUCTIVE, cancels a service invoice (NFS-e) at the city's tax system. This cannot be undone and may have tax effects. Use only when the user asked to cancel that invoice. Invoice key. DELETE /v1/companies/{company_id}/serviceinvoices/{id}.

companyId.description: NFe.io id (from the list or get tools).

invoiceId.description: NFe.io id (from the list or get tools).
